title: inventory.reservation.rejected — Payload Schema
description: Emitted by erp.inventory when a reservation request cannot be fulfilled — typically because aggregate_available is insufficient at the requested location. Commerce must cancel or hold the order and notify the buyer. No inventory.stock.updated is emitted for a rejection because aggregate_available was not modified.

order_id.description: Identifier of the Commerce order whose reservation was rejected.

product_id.description: Stable product identifier from ERP Core.

location_id.description: Location at which the reservation was attempted.

quantity_requested.description: Number of units requested by the order.

quantity_available.description: aggregate_available at the moment of the attempt. May be zero. Commerce may use this to offer a partial fulfillment alternative, but must not assume this value is still valid by the time the buyer responds.

rejection_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for rejection. insufficient_stock: not enough aggregate_available. location_unavailable: the location is closed or suspended. product_discontinued: the product was removed from ERP before the reservation could be processed.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the rejection was committed in ERP Core.
